assignment.title: Soft Touch to Speed
assignment.note: Soft touches, quick feet—speed up only while the ball stays close.

drills.title: Toe Taps
drills.instructions:
Setup: Place the ball on the ground in front of you in a clear space.
Alternate light toe taps on the ball, switching feet each touch. Start slowly and build the rhythm only while you stay balanced and in control.
Focus: Keep the taps soft and your balance steady.

drills.title: Inside–Outside Cone Touches
drills.instructions:
Setup: Set four cones in a straight line about a yard apart, with room to turn at the end.
Use the inside and outside of the active foot to dribble down the line and back. Keep that same foot for the whole interval; the next interval uses the other foot. Start slowly and speed up only while the ball stays close.
Focus: Use small inside and outside touches to guide the ball around each cone.

drills.title: Close-Control Cone Circuit
drills.instructions:
Setup: Set four cones in a small square and a fifth in the middle. Leave enough room to turn comfortably between them.
Dribble around the middle and outside cones, using both feet. Change direction and repeat. Begin slowly, then build speed only while each touch stays within easy reach.
Focus: Soft, close touches. Stay in control through each turn.
